title: Expert Controlling

Lead cross-functional finance transformation and performance improvement projects, bringing a structured consulting approach from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and implementation. Act as a challenging thought partner to Finance and business stakeholders, combining analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and management reporting, particularly for asset performance, fixed costs, financial KPIs and value drivers. Apply coding, automation and AI capabilities to improve forecasting, analytics, reporting efficiency and decision support. Your profile Education: Master degree (finance/controlling) More than 5 years relevant work experience, preferably in controlling, finance & accounting in the oil industry, ideally combining corporate finance experience with a Big 4. CFA qualification or comparable advanced finance expertise, with strong understanding of financial statements, valuation, capital allocation and financial steering. Strong knowledge of value-based management, financial KPI frameworks and the relationship between operational drivers, profitability, cash generation and capital employed. Excellent financial modelling capabilities with the ability to independently structure and solve complex analytical problems. Strong project and stakeholder management skills, comfortable leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation. Advanced Power BI and Excel capabilities; coding, data analytics and automation experience are a strong advantage. Strong interest and practical orientation toward AI and emerging finance technologies, particularly their application within FP&A and Controlling. Consulting-style mindset: structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, executive communication and strong delivery orientation. What OMV Petrom can offer you Long weekend plans are always welcome - on Friday, our office hours end at 14:00. You can rely on a health insurance that covers medical treatment in a variety of private medical clinics. You can work from home, if the work activity allows. The number of your days off increase according to your work experience so that you'll enjoy more free time. We aim to make your vacation days happier, by paying each vacation day double. Are you a top performer? Your work can be rewarded each three months based on performance results. Additional days off and various financial support for different events like marriage, child birth, etc. Access to LinkedIn Learning and a variety of development programs. Do you prefer cars or bikes? We have free private parking.

title: Plant Controller
description: Your contribution to something big Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers? As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing , partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions. You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance. Your key responsibilities Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions. Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs. Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures. Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations. Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control. Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools. What distinguishes you You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role. Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable. We are looking for someone with: Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box . We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights. Who you are You are curious about the business behind the numbers . When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it . You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset. You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

title: Master Thesis: Development & evaluation of ML models for catalysts in exhaust aftertreatment systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background The transportation industry is undergoing one of the largest transformations in its history. Digitalization, sustainability, and artificial intelligence are changing how vehicles are designed, tested, and developed. At Volvo Group, we want to remain at the forefront of this transformation by developing innovative and sustainable technologies that keep society moving. Combustion engines will continue to play a role in the future transportation portfolio. To meet demanding emissions requirements, they rely on advanced exhaust aftertreatment systems that reduce pollutants under highly dynamic operating conditions and throughout the vehicle’s lifetime. Developing these systems is complex, expensive, and time-consuming. Detailed physical models can provide valuable insight into catalyst behavior, but they may also require considerable resources. Machine learning and other AI methods may offer opportunities to develop faster models, explore large datasets, and accelerate engineering workflows. However, they also have the limitation of not being a physical interpretation of the system, and controlling quality and data requirements are still a challenge. In this thesis, you will explore the boundary between physical modelling and machine learning. You will develop and compare ML-based surrogate models for dynamic catalyst systems, investigate how model architecture and calibration affect their performance, and identify when these methods provide real engineering value. Objective The objective of this thesis is to systematically evaluate compact machine learning architectures for dynamic modelling of catalysts used in exhaust aftertreatment systems, such as DOC, SCR, ASC, and DPF systems. The study will assess how model architecture, hyperparameters, calibration, and training-data coverage affect prediction accuracy, robustness, extrapolation, physical interpretability, data requirements, and computational performance. The results will support the development of common guidelines for the reproducibility, validation, quality assessment, and appropriate use of ML-based catalyst models. The project will also explore how physical models, machine learning, and automated modelling pipelines can be combined to manage information across multiple scales, from molecular and catalyst behavior to complete vehicle operation. Candidate Profile You will receive active support and guidance from experienced simulation engineers. In return, we expect you to take initiative, work systematically, and drive the project forward within the agreed scope and timeframe. You are a curious, analytical and motivated master’s student with an interest in combining engineering fundamentals, simulation, data analysis, and machine learning. Are pursuing an MSc in Chemical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related engineering or scientific field. Have a solid understanding of, and interest in, reaction engineering and chemical kinetics. Have experience with MATLAB and Python. Are interested in developing your knowledge of statistics, thermodynamics, exploratory data analysis, and machine learning. Enjoy solving complex technical problems and transforming data into engineering understanding. Are comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your part of the project. Are proficient in English, both verbally and in writing. Experience with any of the following will be considered an advantage: Time-series machine learning GT-SUITE Combustion engines Exhaust aftertreatment systems Practical info: Supervisors: Andres Suarez, 1D simulation engineer & Magnus Walander, Senior 1D simulation engineer. title: Trade Finance Officer

title: M&A Investment Director
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Volvo Penta - Gothenburg Volvo Penta is strengthening its central Strategy & M&A function to support the company’s ambitious growth journey and transformation toward sustainable solutions in marine and industrial applications. We are now looking for an M&A Investment Director who will play a key role in contributing to and leading strategic initiatives and transactions across the company. This is an important role with clear business impact and close collaboration with senior leadership, offering broad responsibility across the full transaction lifecycle within a global industrial company - while leveraging the strength of the Volvo Group M&A network. The Role As M&A Investment Director, you will play an active role in shaping and executing Volvo Penta’s M&A agenda, from identifying opportunities and leading transaction projects to supporting long-term value creation. You will work closely with the CEO, CFO, and Executive Team, combining solid analytical capabilities with a pragmatic, business-driven approach. You are able to create structure, build alignment, and move topics forward in close collaboration with senior stakeholders. You have hands-on experience with M&A transactions, and particularly valuable experiences would be post-M&A activities such as portfolio governance, integration, and value creation. This is a role with broad visibility, meaningful influence, and development opportunities in a purpose-driven and collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities • Drive the consolidation and prioritization of the Volvo Penta M&A pipeline, based on strategic direction and market insights • Lead or support transaction processes, including target evaluation, due diligence, negotiations, and integration, together with stakeholders in the Volvo Penta organization and in the Volvo Group M&A team • Perform financial analysis, valuation, and business case development • Prepare clear, insightful materials for Executive Team and Board discussions • Contribute to post-acquisition follow-up, integration, and long-term value creation • Support strategic planning and portfolio development, in close collaboration with senior stakeholders Your Profile You are a structured and commercially minded professional with a solid analytical foundation and the ability to turn complex insights into actionable outcomes. You combine drive with humility and thrive in an ambitious and supportive team. We believe several of the following experiences and capabilities will help you succeed: • Relevant experience from M&A, preferably from another industrial company • Strong financial and analytical skills, including valuation and business case development • Experience with transaction processes and working in multi-stakeholder environments • Clear and confident communication skills in Swedish and English • A curious, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset • Strong skills in PowerPoint and Excel • A relevant academic degree, for example in Finance, Business, Industrial Engineering, or similar Just as importantly, you bring a collaborative approach, sound judgment, and a genuine interest in contributing to both team success and long-term business impact. We value different perspectives and experiences. If this role excites you, even if your background does not match every point above, we encourage you to apply. Why Volvo Penta? At Volvo Penta, you will be part of a company committed to shaping the future of sustainable power solutions. Our ambition is to significantly scale Volvo Penta, both organically and inorganically. We believe in empowering our people, fostering inclusive teams, and creating an environment where different perspectives lead to better decisions. You will join a team where trust, collaboration, and continuous learning are key, and where you will have the opportunity to make a real impact on the company’s future. Im Verlauf des Programms (12-24 Monate) kombinierst du Personal- und kaufmännische Stationen in Deutschland und im Ausland, arbeitest an strategisch relevanten Projekten und baust ein umfassendes Verständnis dafür auf, wie Menschen, Organisation und Geschäftserfolg zusammenwirken. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und erlebst, wie wirtschaftliche Steuerung, Transformation und wirksame Personalarbeit zusammenspielen. So entwickelst du ein breites Verständnis für unser Geschäft und bereitest dich gezielt auf deine weitere Karriere im kaufmännischen oder HR-Management vor. Digitalisierung, Transformation und neue Geschäftsmodelle verstehst du als Chancen, die du aktiv mitgestalten möchtest. title: Thesis Worker Evaluation of AI-enabled tools for Product Development Workflows
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Master’s Thesis Proposal This thesis is suitable for a student in mechanical engineering or product development, or a related discipline. The preferred start date is January 2027. Background Product development increasingly involves digital tools that support engineering workflows. AI-enabled tools may offer new ways to carry out tasks, access information and support collaboration. To understand their potential value, it is important to assess how well they support real product development needs, as well as their limitations and practical requirements. This thesis will compare two such tools for product development workflows. The work will be carried out at Engineering Method Development Dept. in Eskilstuna within Volvo CE. Project Summary The objective is to evaluate and compare the two tools in selected product development workflows. Together with Volvo engineers, the student will identify relevant use cases, define assessment criteria and conduct a structured evaluation of both tools. The study will consider their suitability for the selected workflows and develop recommendations for their potential use and further evaluation. Activities: Literature review on AI-enabled tools and their use in product development workflows. Identification and selection of relevant product development use cases. Definition of evaluation criteria, such as usability, workflow fit, output quality and practical limitations. Evaluation of each tool using the selected use cases. Analysis and comparison of the results. Development of recommendations and proposals for further work. Preparation of a technical report. Presentation at Eskilstuna site and the relevant university. Deliverables: Technical report. Comparative evaluation of the tools for the selected workflows. Recommendations for potential use and further evaluation. Contact Details The thesis will be supervised by Michael Hultman and Joakim Lundin. Questions can be directed to Michael Hultman at michael.hultman@volvo.com or +46 73 558 5847. Last application day 1st of December. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

description: Ready to steer Bosch's performance? title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming Battery Energy Storage Systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background The increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability. Research Question The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems. Objectives Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication. Improve dynamic response during power dispatch. Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing. Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations. Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs. Scope Of Work Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4] Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12] Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21] Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26] Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29] Candidate Competencies Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable. Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit. Ready for the next move? description: Entity: Supply, Trading & Shipping Job Family Group: Supply & Trading Group Job Description: About bp Our purpose is to bring together people, energy and markets to power and navigate a changing world. In a time of constant change and possibility we need new talent to pursue commercial opportunities, fueled by world-class insight and expertise. This role will bridge Sales, Supply, Pricing/Costing, Analytics, and Marketing , helping the sales organization understand market conditions, identify high-potential prospects, and translate market and customer data into actionable commercial opportunities. The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of U.S. power markets with analytical, research, communication, and commercial skills. They should be comfortable supporting customer meetings, researching prospects, developing market insights, and turning complex information into clear recommendations for Sales. Key Accountabilities Market Intelligence & Sales Support Serve as a market subject-matter resource for the East Sales team, with a focus on U.S. power markets and Eastern markets . Supervise wholesale power markets, capacity, congestion, transmission, renewable requirements, regulatory developments, and other factors impacting retail electricity pricing. Provide market expertise and analytical support during customer and broker meetings , helping Sales explain market conditions, pricing trends, risks, and opportunities. Develop concise market updates, talking points, presentations, and other materials that Sales can use with customers and brokers. Provide customer-specific market analysis and insights to support sales strategies and customer engagement. Translate sophisticated market information into clear, commercially relevant insights . Prospect Intelligence & Lead Generation Research and identify high-potential commercial and industrial prospects within target markets and customer segments. Use market, customer, industry, and company data to identify and prioritize attractive sales opportunities. Develop prospect profiles incorporating relevant information such as locations, estimated electricity usage, market exposure, business characteristics, sustainability initiatives, and potential buying indicators . Identify trigger events that may create opportunities for outreach, including facility expansions, acquisitions, new locations, sustainability initiatives, regulatory changes, and contract or renewal timing. Develop targeted prospect lists and account intelligence that enable Sales to conduct more focused and relevant outreach . Partner with Sales to refine target customer profiles and continuously identify new sources of qualified leads. Data & Commercial Analytics Analyze internal and external data to identify sales opportunities, market trends, customer segments, and commercial insights . Develop dashboards, reports, and recurring intelligence to help Sales leadership understand market opportunity, pipeline, customer trends, and competitive positioning. Partner with Pricing/Costing and Supply to interpret market movements and their implications for retail pricing and competitiveness. Identify trends and opportunities that warrant further analysis and communicate findings to Sales leadership. Support strategic projects related to market expansion, customer growth, and commercial strategy. Marketing & Thought Leadership Partner with Marketing to develop market-driven campaigns, customer communications, presentations, newsletters, and thought leadership . Provide market data, trends, charts, and analysis for external marketing and sales materials. Identify market developments that can support targeted prospect and customer campaigns . Help develop content that demonstrates the company's expertise and credibility in energy markets. Support webinars, customer events, sales presentations, and other market-facing initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration Build strong relationships across Sales, Supply, Pricing/Costing, Risk, Marketing, and Analytics . Act as a connector between market intelligence and commercial execution.

title: Bachelor thesis A Financial Framework for Prioritizing Online Condition Monitoring Implementation
description: Help Shape the Future of Smart Maintenance. As manufacturing becomes increasingly data-driven, organizations are looking for smarter ways to improve equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and maximize production availability. Online condition monitoring is a key enabler of this transformation, helping businesses move from reactive maintenance toward predictive and proactive strategies. We are now looking for two Bachelor students who want to explore how economic and operational data can be used to make better investment decisions regarding condition monitoring technologies. Thesis Scope The aim of this thesis is to investigate how online condition monitoring systems can be prioritized and implemented from an economic perspective. The project will focus on developing a decision support tool that helps identify where condition monitoring can create the greatest business value. The thesis is expected to: Develop a framework for evaluating condition monitoring opportunities across manufacturing equipment Assess machine criticality, maintenance costs, production availability, and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Combine technical and business-related data into a structured decision support tool Identify where condition monitoring solutions can generate the highest value Recommend approaches for improving maintenance planning, reducing costs, and increasing operational availability This project offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, maintenance, operations, and business economics while contributing to the future of smart manufacturing. Who We Believe You Are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree within: Production Engineering Mechanical Engineering Industrial Economics Or a related field You have an interest in manufacturing, maintenance, data analysis, and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex problems and can combine analytical thinking with a practical business perspective. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience within a leading global manufacturing organization Exposure to predictive maintenance and condition monitoring technologies Opportunities to work with both technical and business stakeholders Insights into how data-driven decision-making supports operational excellence Valuable experience in developing practical tools that can support real business decisions Practical Information Thesis Level: Bachelor's Thesis Number of Students: 2 Location: Volvo Group Language: Swedish or English Semester: Spring 2027 Application Deadline: November 30, 2026 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Developer & Business Analyst – PnL & Risk Systems
description: This role is ideal for a passionate, entrepreneurially minded developer who thrives on ownership , impact , and a dynamic environment. You will have end-to-end ownership of the solutions you deliver, from the first conversation with the business to final rollout and beyond. You will be trusted to shape the best approach to delivering against business priorities and timelines, in a flat, team-oriented environment that values ideas and individual contributions. Your role We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office, with P&L reporting and price risk management, down to invoicing – for every commodity we trade, including electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. We place our CTRM at the heart of how the company operates; it is used daily by teams across trading, middle office, finance and operations. Our most critical systems are built in-house by teams like ours, helping orchestrate global energy flows. What defines success in this role: Technical excellence : design and implement clean, well-documented and extensible features. Write maintainable, high-performance code. Ownership: work with a high degree of autonomy and take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your deliverables: requirements, design, development, testing, rollout, training and ongoing support. Business partnership : engage directly with trading desks, finance and senior management to identify and prioritise requirements. There is no intermediary: you are both the business analyst and the developer. You go beyond what users explicitly ask for: understanding the context, spotting pain points they may not articulate directly, and building what truly serves the business. Teamwork : end-to-end ownership does not mean working alone. Your work integrates into a much larger system, and you stay closely connected with other development teams. You will become a trusted partner to colleagues and stakeholders across the firm. As we work as one united team covering PnL, Risk, VAR and options, the projects may be as diverse as: Helping redesign our CTRM reporting architecture to enable fast, scalable access for the demands of an AI-driven world Modelling cash-for-product loan repayments in our Finance P&L Building a valuation engine for complex options that we trade Running a systems integration with a company we have acquired For large projects, you may travel to other Vitol main offices – Houston, Singapore, London, Rotterdam – to ensure smooth integration and adoption on the ground. Our technology Our core technologies, PL/SQL and Oracle Forms Builder, form the foundation of our core trading platform and have been central to Vitol's success story. When you join, you will work with these established technologies to quickly get up to speed with our data model and business logic, and start adding value from day one. As our platform continues to evolve, we are progressively embracing a more contemporary technology stack, creating opportunities for those interested to be part of shaping what comes next. Required University degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or an equivalent field At least 3 years' experience as a software engineer, ideally in a role combining technical and functional responsibilities Proven data modelling skills to translate business situations into data structures Proficiency in SQL Team player with strong entrepreneurial drive and ability to work independently Proactive and user-focused "make it work" mentality with a genuine interest in both the functional and technical aspects of each challenge Comfortable with a daily release cycle and a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging with non-technical and senior stakeholders Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken Nice to have Experience with PL/SQL (preferred) or a similar procedural DB programming language (e.g. T-SQL) Practical experience with Oracle Forms builder Previous experience in the commodities and/or trading industry Familiarity with PnL, accounting, or risk concepts French is a plus

title: Senior Energy Transition Partner
description: At Maersk, we are working to enable the transition towards net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2040. Our Energy Transition Commercialization (ETC) team turns that transition into customer value. We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Energy Transition Partner to drive customer collaboration on alternative fuels and shape the organisations understanding of what creating customer value within ocean decarbonisation means. Working closely with the Head of ETC, you will lead major opportunities and tenders with some of Maersk's largest customers and help shape our go-to-market. Key Responsibilities Commercial growth and customer engagement Responsible for the strategy, go-to-market and delivery of the largest ECO Delivery vertical, representing nearly a third of the portfolio today. Developing the forwarder segment including segment specific solutioning as a growth lever in the portfolio. Lead customer discussions, tenders, and negotiations through to contracted and loaded volumes. Build trusted senior relationships with customer decision makers and proactively create new demand. Ocean decarbonisation solutions & go-to-market Position ECO Delivery Ocean and our wider low-emission ocean solutions as a source of customer value. Turn customer demand and fuel availability into concrete go-to-market strategy and actions. Strong understanding of decarbonisation, alternative marine fuels, and related standards and regulation. Customer-centric mindset, strong executive presence, and stakeholder management across functions and geographies. Full professional proficiency in English. title: Lead Quant Analyst- Power Trading (m/f/d)
description: This is a high-impact role focused on shaping and enhancing the analytical framework that supports trading decisions across European power markets. The successful candidate will combine deep analytical expertise with a strong understanding of commercial trading environments. This is a key role in identifying market opportunities, developing analytical tools and frameworks, and ensuring that insights can be translated into actionable trading strategies and P&L generation. This position requires an individual who can work closely with traders, understand their requirements, independently develop solutions, and continuously challenge and improve the desk's analytical capabilities. This will be a full time position based in Dusseldorf, reporting into the Head of Continental Power Trading. The responsibilities will include as follows: Develop, enhance, and maintain analytical models, tools, and frameworks supporting European power trading activities. Translate complex market fundamentals, exposures, and trading opportunities into clear and actionable insights. Analyse market trends, supply-demand dynamics, generation, weather, transmission constraints, interconnectors, and other key drivers of power prices. Maintain and develop internal and external relationships to strengthen market intelligence. Evaluate existing analytical capabilities and define a roadmap for future development. Identify gaps in current tools, datasets, and market intelligence capabilities. Recommend and implement improvements to strengthen the desk's analytical edge. Work directly alongside traders to understand trading requirements and convert them into practical analytical solutions. Contribute ideas that enhance the desk's ability to generate P&L across European power markets. Communicate progress, priorities, requirements, and obstacles clearly and proactively. University degree in Mathematics, Economics, Science or similar. Substantial experience and proven track record in fundamental analysis and modelling of the European Power markets, ideally across more than one trading house. Extensive hands-on experience building and running fundamental models, with a track record of using them to form a clear, independent view on the market. In-depth knowledge of the German, French and UK power markets and the drivers that link them Knowledge of cross-border power flows, interconnectors, transmission constraints, and capacity markets. Strong understanding of how weather affects power demand, renewable output and prices A minimum of 5 years of experience operating in a commercial trading environment where analytics directly supported trading and revenue generation. Strong understanding of how traders identify opportunities, construct positions, and generate profit. Ability to take the models, data and tools we already have, build on them and improve them, rather than recreate what you have done elsewhere. A creative and curious approach, open to new methods and not tied to one way of doing things. Confidence to advise the Head of the Continental Power Trading desk on strategy, turning analysis into clear recommendations rather than just producing data. Demonstrated ability to independently deliver analytical projects from concept through implementation. A clear preference for analytics over trading, and motivation to build long-term analytical capability. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage in effective and direct communication at all levels. Strong analytical, problem-solving, with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Python.

Come join us at AstraZeneca in the role as a Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy . Shape governance for AI- and data-related risk by providing clear insight, reporting, and recommendations to relevant decision-making forums. Collaborate with and influences external stakeholders and regulatory bodies , representing AstraZeneca’s quality position and helping to shape expectations in evolving areas of science and technology. Provide expert input into quality and compliance risk management , including identification, assessment, mitigation planning and monitoring. title: Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer - Battery Energy Storage Systems - Volvo Energy
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Working at Volvo Energy is different Do you want to make the world a better place and love architecting digital solutions? Welcome to a team unified by an important mission, great ideas, fun, diversity, and inclusiveness. Our colleagues are - and will always be - the most important part of the story. Whilst demands are high, there is also plenty of opportunities to learn and grow - as a professional and as a person. We look for colleagues that thoroughly enjoy our intrapreneurial journey, can hit the ground running and lead with passion, perform with purpose and transform with vision. Moreover, it will be essential you have a strong ability to form trustful relationships to effectively work with partners - inside and outside of the Volvo Group – in a cross-functional manner. You will make a difference! Volvo Energy Digital & IT Digital & IT is a function within Volvo Energy. We support our customers transition to a carbon-free world through great Digital solutions and experiences that users love and enables customers to shift to fossil-free operations. We truly care about the customer’s business in terms of up-time, safety, productivity and of course 100% green energy supply. We aim at having industry-leading simplicity and usability for our digital services, such as routing, find-book-pay and charging operator systems. The energy transition will not come for free – but we are committed to support this transition by hard and dedicated work. So - what are we looking for in this specific role? Volvo Energy is providing a highly qualified digital platform, an Energy Management System (EMS), to control our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are now looking for Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer that will support in establishing cyber secure connectivity towards BESS units and the BESS digital twin using the appointed Volvo Energy Site Controller. As the energy space rely on standards for interoperability between energy systems, like Modbus, IEC 60870-5, 61850 and DNP-3, you make sure that the IoT Edge solution is designed according to cyber security standards. You also ensure cyber secure connectivity to the Volvo Energy EMS solution via MQTT/OPC-UA as defined by the Volvo Energy target architecture. You will work closely together with several different qualified teams to help design and build the solution and report functionally to the Volvo Energy Head of Enterprise architecture. Key Responsibilities In this role, you’ll take the lead in shaping the OT network architecture that powers our BESS units around the world. You’ll design secure, scalable network environments—everything from segmentation and VLAN structures to DMZ zones and redundancy strategies—both for our own products and for customer sites. As the technical owner of our OT networking landscape, you’ll create and maintain clear, high‑quality diagrams and documentation that bring structure to complex systems and ensure smooth integration with cloud platforms and external SCADA/EMS solutions. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. title: Product Owner (Commercial Data Products)
description: Are you interested in turning complex business needs into data products that make a real difference? As a Product Owner within our Commercial Data Products and Reporting team, you will own and develop data products that help our Commercial and Commercial Finance teams make better, faster and more consistent decisions. You will manage a portfolio of data products, including datasets and data cubes used for commercial analysis and reporting. Sitting between business and technology, you will translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements, shape solutions with our technology teams, and ensure we focus our efforts on the work that creates the greatest value. Our team brings together Product Owners based in Copenhagen and reporting colleagues in Pune, and you will collaborate with colleagues across business, data and technology. Please note that this role is based in Copenhagen and requires onsite presence in the office five days per week. What you’ll be doing Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for your assigned commercial data products. Work closely with Commercial, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear requirements and user stories. Act as a trusted sparring partner and bridge between business and technology, translating business needs into technically informed requirements while constructively challenging assumptions and proposed solutions. Prioritise the backlog based on business value, technical feasibility and delivery capacity. Partner with technology teams to shape scalable data solutions and support delivery through Agile ways of working. Apply your understanding of data models, data sourcing and transformation processes to ask the right questions and constructively challenge proposed solutions. Support the development and evolution of datasets, data cubes, KPIs and reporting foundations. Identify and shape opportunities to embed AI and automation into our data products, while also using AI to improve how we explore, design and deliver solutions. Collaborate closely with our reporting team and other Product Owners to ensure our data products work effectively across the wider organisation. Promote consistent KPI definitions, strong data quality and trusted reporting in line with our One Set of Numbers principle. Drive adoption, monitor product performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for You combine strong product thinking with enough technical understanding to work confidently across business, data and technology teams. You do not need to be a hands-on data engineer, but you should understand how data is sourced, transformed, structured and delivered well enough to engage with and challenge technical colleagues when needed. Your background could be in product ownership, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, finance, commercial performance or another related field. We welcome different career paths and are interested in the capabilities and experience you bring. We’re looking for someone with: Approximately 5+ years’ experience working with data products, BI, analytics, data engineering, reporting or product ownership. Experience translating business needs into user stories, requirements and prioritised backlogs. A good conceptual understanding of data models, datasets and data-transformation processes such as ETL. AI-enabled product development: Experience or a strong interest in delivering AI-enabled products and using AI tools throughout the product lifecycle, from exploring requirements and shaping solutions to improving delivery and ways of working. You bring curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and can identify where they can create meaningful business value. Experience working with technical teams using Agile principles and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar. Strong stakeholder skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear and accessible way. Good business acumen and curiosity about how data can improve commercial decisions. A proactive mindset and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for improvement. Experience within commercial, sales, finance, logistics or shipping would be beneficial, but is not essential. Ready to make an impact? title: Business Controller
description: Do you enjoy driving business performance from a central finance position? Are you an experienced finance professional who can turn complex financial data into strategic insights? Do you thrive in a role where you oversee the bigger picture, steer reporting processes, and support senior management with decision-making? We are looking for a Business Controller to join the Business Control team within Vattenfall's rapidly growing E-Mobility Business Unit. In this central controlling role, you will be responsible for providing insights into the overall financial performance of the Business Unit. You will act as a key partner to senior management, ensuring high-quality financial reporting, forecasting, planning, and performance steering across multiple countries and business areas. Working closely with Business Control colleagues, Finance teams, and senior stakeholders, you will help translate financial results into actionable insights that support the continued growth and development of Vattenfall's E-Mobility business. What will you do? As Senior Business Controller, you will play a key role in steering the overall financial performance of the E-Mobility Business Unit and ensuring a reliable and efficient reporting framework. You will: Coordinate and steer the monthly performance reporting cycle for the overall Business Unit. Consolidate financial results across countries, functions, and business areas into clear management reporting. Deliver insights and analyses on business performance, key value drivers, risks, and opportunities. Lead forecasting activities and translate business developments into reliable financial outlooks. Drive the annual budget and business planning process for the Business Unit. Support senior management with strategic analyses, business cases, and decision-making. Further develop and improve reporting standards, controlling processes, and governance frameworks. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in financial reporting and performance measurement. Collaborate closely with Business Controllers, Accounting, and Finance teams across different countries. Identify opportunities to automate and enhance reporting tools, KPIs, and management information. Contribute to cross-functional improvement initiatives that support the continued growth of E-Mobility. You will report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility and work closely with stakeholders across multiple countries and disciplines. Who are you? You are able to combine strong analytical capabilities with a strategic mindset and enjoy understanding how financial performance connects to broader business objectives. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, creating structure in complex environments, and translating financial outcomes into meaningful insights for senior stakeholders. You can switch effortlessly between detailed financial analysis and high-level performance discussions. With a proactive and collaborative approach, you build strong relationships across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement. We believe you bring: At least 7 years of experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or a similar finance-related role. A master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience with consolidated reporting, forecasting, and business planning in a complex international organisation. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience working with senior stakeholders and management teams. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear and actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with SAP and reporting tools is highly valued. Full professional proficiency in English. Experience within the utilities, energy, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive industries is considered an advantage. Location: Berlin, Stockholm or Amsterdam

description: Ready to make a real impact with data? We are looking for analytically strong and tech-savvy master’s graduates with a drive to make a difference, who will drive Bosch's data-driven transformation with us in our Junior Managers Program. If you burn for data analytics, machine learning, and strategic challenges and aspire to build a leadership career, we want to meet you.​ Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will rotate through predominantly commercial and IT-related departments in Germany and abroad. Your mission is to gain a deep understanding of our business and data-driven decision-making processes, while building expertise in data analytics, digitalization, and machine learning.​ You will analyze complex challenges, identify optimization potentials along our business processes, and collaborate with specialist departments to develop innovative, data-based, digital solutions. title: Senior Business Analyst
description: Digital Transformation plays a critical role across Statkraft’s value chains. In Markets, reliable digital solutions, strong analytical capabilities and close collaboration between business and technology are essential to manage risk, support financial reporting and make well-informed commercial decisions. Many of our business-critical systems are developed and maintained in-house. We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join the team responsible for Beacon, our Portfolio and Risk Management platform, as well as the team responsible for Risk IT Tools, a suite of business-critical solutions that bridge business and IT and support risk analysts, quant teams, and developers. Together, these teams play a key role in enabling efficient risk management, reporting, analytics, and process automation across Statkraft's trading landscape. As a Senior Business Analyst you will: Act as a key link between Markets and IT, connecting business needs with effective digital solutions. Work with business users, quantitative analysts and developers to understand needs and translate them into clear requirements and acceptance criteria. Analyse financial models, valuation methodologies, quantitative calculations and business processes to support solution development. Coordinate dependencies between Beacon, internal models and the wider Risk IT landscape. Drive priorities and support delivery from initial business need through implementation, testing and validation. Support the continuous improvement of risk management, reporting, analytics and process automation solutions. Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to ensure solutions work effectively across systems and meet business needs. The position may be based in either Oslo or Düsseldorf, depending on the competence and profile of the successful candidate. We are looking for colleagues who are excited to make an impact and bring a mix of mindset and skills to the team. This includes: Extensive experience as a Business Analyst in complex, business-critical IT or digital product environments. Strong analytical and financial-market knowledge, including an understanding of financial models, valuation methodologies and quantitative calculations. Relevant experience in areas such as energy trading, derivatives, risk management, valuation, market or credit risk, or financial reporting. title: Volvo Group Graduate Program 2027 - Strategic Portfolio Planning
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program A new era of manufacturing and R&D is here. Are you passionate about technology, eager to solve real business challenges, ready to drive innovation, and join our transformation journey? Then this Graduate program is for you! As part of the Graduate Program at Volvo Group, you will tackle real challenges from day one and contribute to the development of next-generation production solutions. The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. We manage the strategic and tactical portfolio, setting direction and prioritizing where our efforts matter most. Our team leads key business, portfolio and technology strategies and we shape Volvo CE's overall depth of engagement and global technology footprint. We also scan the horizon for future portfolio business opportunities, assessing their strategic fit and potential to help guide what comes next. How you’ll contribute As part of a global team working across our company portfolio and customer ecosystem gaps, you will drive a more data-driven approach to our future investments and priorities. By combining this strategic mindset with Volvo CE's overall portfolio planning, you will help strengthen our future offering and keep us competitive as a company. Positioned at the center of our main stakeholders, including technology, regions, finance, and strategic leaders, you will manage these relationships to build alignment. Communicating this data-driven approach, you will keep business and customer needs at the forefront of the conversation. This will help us balance our experienced ways of working in portfolio management with greater reliance on data, a process that brings valuable learnings in change leadership. You will also translate these needs into concrete content and priorities. Who are you? We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights and supporting the development of others. title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in HR, Business & Strategy
description: Shape the future of HR and Business with us! We are looking for master’s graduates with entrepreneurial thinking and a drive to make a difference, who want to take on responsibility and prepare for a career in HR or commercial management in our Junior Managers Program. Do you think business-mindedly, act with a people-oriented perspective, and want to develop sustainable solutions for Bosch? Then we want to hear from you.​ Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will combine HR and commercial rotations in Germany and abroad, work on strategically relevant projects, and build a comprehensive understanding of how people, organization, and business success interact. Depending on your profile and development goals, you will gain insights into areas such as HR Strategy, Digitalization, HR Business Partnering, Talent Management, and Organizational Development, as well as Controlling, Finance, or Business Development. Your mission: connect business-driven decisions with a strong people perspective.​ You won't just support—you will shape, decide, and take on responsibility. You will bring in your own ideas and experience firsthand how financial steering, transformation, and effective HR work interact. This way, you will develop a broad understanding of our business and purposefully prepare for your future career in commercial or HR management.​ What you will learn and develop with us:​ You will learn how a global technology company is steered and how people strategy, finance, markets, processes, and organization collectively contribute to business success. You will actively shape strategic and operational projects, for example in the areas of restructuring and M&A, employer branding, performance management, or digitalization. You will take ownership of your own work packages or projects, prepare executive management decisions, and implement sustainable improvements together with international and local teams. You will develop your personal career profile through deliberately combined HR and business rotations, regular feedback, and guidance from your personal executive-level mentor. Your academic foundation:​ You have graduated with an outstanding full-time Master's degree, e.g., in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Human Resources Management, Business Psychology, or a related field of study. Ideally, you combine a commercial focus with a strong interest in people and organizational topics. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, a PhD, or initial relevant work experience.​ Qualifications Your passion for Business & People:​ You do not want to look at commercial relationships in isolation, but want to understand how strategy, organization, and people create impact together. Initial practical experience in at least one of the fields of HR, Controlling, Finance, Purchasing, Sales, Strategy, or Business Development is required.​ Your eye for the bigger picture:​ You think entrepreneurially, recognize connections across functional boundaries, and can derive clear options for action from data, market requirements, and employee perspectives. Your understanding of human-centric leadership:​ You can inspire people, approach others openly, and build trusting relationships. You are convinced that sustainable performance is created through clear goals, collaboration, and the development of people.​ You think strategically and shape the future:​ You challenge existing processes, develop sustainable solutions, and drive topics forward from analysis to implementation. You view digitalization, transformation, and new business models as opportunities that you want to actively help shape.​ Your career ambition:​ You want to take on responsibility and develop into a leader over the long term. You are open to various career paths, for example in HR Management, in an HR Business Partner role, in Controlling, in Strategy, or in another commercial function.​ Your continuous development:​ You are curious, learn quickly, and actively use new tasks, perspectives, and feedback for your personal growth. Moving between HR and business contexts motivates you and consciously broadens your profile.​ Your language proficiency: You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and ideally possess good German language skills. You have already gained at least three months of international experience and are open to a rotation in an international environment. #LikeABosch

title: Financial Accountant (m/w/d)
description: Anfang dieses Jahres (März 2026) hat Unilever eine Vereinbarung zur Abspaltung unseres Foods-Geschäfts bekannt gegeben. Unser Foods-Geschäft mit Marken wie Hellmann's und Knorr wird mit McCormick zusammengeführt und soll zu einem globalen Marktführer im Bereich Geschmack werden – mit führenden Positionen bei Gewürzen, Würzmischungen, Saucen und ergänzenden Lebensmittelkategorien, gestützt auf eine starke Handels- und Foodservice-Plattform. McCormick blickt auf eine mehr als 135-jährige Geschichte zurück, ist in über 150 Ländern und Gebieten aktiv und verfügt über ein Portfolio vertrauter Marken. Die Transaktion steht noch unter dem Vorbehalt von Konsultationen, behördlichen Genehmigungen und weiteren üblichen Abschlussbedingungen; der Abschluss ist für Mitte 2027 geplant. Financial Accountant (m/w/d) Als Financial Accountant übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle, damit das Rechnungswesen und die Berichterstattung unserer deutschen Gesellschaften korrekt und verlässlich sind, und berichtest dabei an den Finance Controller Germany. Du trägst dazu bei, ein wirksames internes Kontrollumfeld aufrechtzuerhalten, die lokalen und konzernweiten Rechnungslegungsvorgaben einzuhalten und interne sowie externe Prüfungen zu unterstützen. Außerdem gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung und Einführung unserer Buchhaltungs-, Reporting- und Kontrollprozesse aktiv mit. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das daran glaubt, Arbeit mit Sinn zu leisten – für Menschen und den Planeten. Denn hier geht es nicht nur um einen Job. Wir laden dich ein, Teil von etwas Größerem zu werden. WAS WERDEN DEINE HAUPTAUFGABEN SEIN Abschlussverantwortung: Du steuerst und koordinierst die monatlichen, vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Abschlussarbeiten deiner Gesellschaften und/oder Buchungskreise nach HGB und Konzernvorgaben (insbesondere US GAAP). Jahresabschlüsse HGB: Du bist hauptverantwortlich für die Erstellung der Jahresabschlüsse mindestens einer Gesellschaft, inklusive Analysen, Abstimmungen und Dokumentation. Bilanzielle Beurteilung: Du analysierst komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und legst in Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die passende bilanzielle Behandlung fest. Abschlussqualität: Du erstellst und prüfst Kontenabstimmungen, Abschlussbuchungen, Abweichungsanalysen und Reporting-Dokumentationen und stellst so zeitgerecht verlässliche Finanzinformationen bereit. title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

title: Head of Global Financial Services
description: Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. We are looking for you, Head of Global Financial Services to join our Group Finance organization in Neste headquarters in Espoo. You will focus on leading a global shared service center, Neste Global Financial Services (GFS), which is responsible for timely and accurate monthly, quarterly and annual statutory reporting to internal stakeholders, external auditors and authorities. The service scope includes Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payments, Asset and Inventory Accounting and General Accounting for Neste subsidiaries across Renewable Products and Oil Products business areas. In this job you will work closely with your own highly skilled GFS leadership team, top-tier finance professionals across the Neste Group, and key function and business stakeholders globally. In our team, you will be part of a well-motivated and experienced group of professionals who are driven to continuously improve our processes and develop our talents. As a team, we aim to elevate our financial operations and support Neste's strategic decision-making. Together with your expertise, we can do meaningful work to drive Neste forward. Reasons to join We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate. We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment. Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging. In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi). More about the job Your role in our team Leading the Global Financial Services department’s overall performance, including heading your own leadership team of 7 direct reports and an organization of 65+ finance professionals based in Espoo, Finland. Ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting while leading robust financial service processes with strong global internal controls. Maintaining and developing the global service delivery model and fostering strong partnerships with key stakeholders and counterparties. Driving end-to-end process development, continuous improvement, and financial service automation. Participating in IT systems renewals and M&A projects to provide all potential new group companies with scalable, proper financial services. Keys to success in this role Applicable education, e.g., Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, combined with at least 10 years of relevant work experience. Proven track record in leadership, including providing strategic direction, coaching managers, driving team performance, and fostering global collaboration. Expertise in timely/accurate reporting, internal control frameworks, and running cost management. Solid knowledge of financial processes, systems (especially SAP FI), and accounting principles (IAS/IFRS and Local GAAPs). Experience in end-to-end process development, automation methods (e.g., RPA and AI), and participation in finance IT system projects. Proactive and analytical approach, high adaptability to changing situations, and a strong sense of ownership. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, positive mindset. Let’s get you started We look forward to receiving your CV and application with a salary request by August 31, 2026. Please note that the review of applications will start already during the application period, so submit your application right away! If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Kaisa Koivuranta, Vice President, Group Finance +358 50 458 4985 on Friday 14
